jobs.title: Project Engineer - Dispatchable Generation Teams, Asset Development
jobs.description:
Vacancy Number: 28643
Category: Engineering \- Project Management
Job Type: Full\-time  

**Position Description**

  

Asset Development is tasked with identifying, developing and constructing new investment opportunities on behalf of ESB Group. Asset Development activities comprise identifying and developing opportunities to enhance our portfolio to realise our Brighter Future strategy. The opportunities are managed through development and construction to commercial operation. The Flexible Technology Development unit within Asset Development has successfully developed flexible generation, battery and synchronous compensator projects in the last two years.


EirGrid and ESB Networks are developing market competitions for building long duration energy storage (LDES) projects. Flexible Technology Development is responsible for developing a pipeline of generation and LDES projects and system support technologies (eg synchronous compensation), along with opportunities for flexible generation assets to meet market requirements.


The successful candidates will support the Project Director on assigned project development activities such as establishing techno\-commercial feasibility of projects, landowner engagement, overseeing planning activities and project design. The role will involve working closely with team members across the various business units in ESB including engineering, planning and legal specialists.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Support project teams in assessing and developing opportunities, including greenfield and brownfield sites, new technologies and acquisitions.
* Engage internal and external stakeholders to secure permits, authorisations, planning and connection agreements.
* Deliver assigned work to ESB project management standards, meeting technical, commercial, legal, procurement and programme requirements.
* Support preparation of projects for market competitions, including storage, capacity and system services.
* Research technology areas with commercial potential.
* Manage procurement and contract strategy, and coordinate project contracts.
* Support delivery of Safe and Sound across all projects.
* Promote a strong team culture and open communication across the project team and Asset Development.
* Research project or industry issues affecting delivery and present conclusions.
  

**Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience**

  

* Ability to assess opportunities across technical, environmental, regulatory, market and financial factors.
* Experience working independently, owning projects.
* Ability to plan and communicate requirements to progress projects and new initiatives.
* Third\-level qualification in engineering, commercial, planning or a related discipline.
* Minimum 5 years’ postgraduate experience.
* Proven experience delivering projects.
  

**Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience**

* Knowledge of planning and permitting for large energy projects.
* Experience negotiating with landowners and managing local stakeholder relationships.
* Knowledge of energy generation technologies and their assessment.
* Knowledge of energy markets and regulatory supports in Ireland and the UK.
* Knowledge of procurement procedures.
* Understanding of the power generation business.
  

**Essential Qualifications**

  

* 3rd level primary degree in engineering, commercial, planning or equivalent work experience.
  

**Desirable Qualifications**


* Project management or other business qualifications that complement the knowledge, skills and experience listed above.
  

**Location**

  

This position will be based in ESB’s Head Office, 27 Fitzwilliam Street Lower, Dublin, D02 KT92\.


Smart Working at ESB is designed to make ‘in\-person’ time together as purposeful as possible while also enabling the effective use of digital tools and hybrid arrangements to preserve our commitment to flexibility. The successful candidate may work flexibly within the jurisdiction where they have been employed, with attendance at the workplace for in\-person collaboration at least two days per week. All Smart Working arrangements are subject to regular review based on the operational requirements of the role, the team, and the business.

  

**Reporting to**

  

Manager Flexible Technologies, Asset Development.

  

**Why Work with Us?**

  

* Work on nationally important dispatchable generation projects that support security of supply, renewable integration and the transition of gas turbine assets toward lower\-carbon and net\-zero fuels.
* Develop your career through mentoring, training and exposure to strategic energy projects.
* Be part of a values\-led, inclusive team culture with opportunities to contribute to Corporate Social Responsibility initiatives.
* Connect with colleagues through sports and social clubs, networking opportunities and a great team environment.
* Access Credit Union membership, a generous pension and staff well\-being programmes.
* Benefit from generous parental leave entitlements and supports that recognise life outside work.
* Join an organisation with a strong commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion.
  

**Salary**  

€59,980 \- €70,564 per annum  

**Closing Date**


15th October 2026

  

**Interview**

  

Candidates who are shortlisted for interview will complete a Behavioural Interview based on each of the following Behaviours, which underpin how we work at ESB and are critical to delivering our strategy:

  

* Accountable and Ethical
* Collaborative
* Growing and Adaptive
* Proactive
* Respectful and Supportive
  

More information available on Our People Promise

  

**Notes**


Your application will be held in reserve for 6 months should you be suitable for the role.


The successful candidate will be required to evidence their right to work in the Republic of Ireland / UK prior to commencement of employment.


**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Statement**


ESB is committed to being an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all sections of society and ensure that no one is discriminated against on the grounds of race, religion or belief, ethnicity or nationality, disability, age, citizenship, marital status, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation or gender identity, or any other basis as protected by law.


Applicants who anticipate requiring assistance or reasonable accommodations for any part of the application or interview process may contact, in confidence, recruitment@esb.ie.


**About ESB**


Join us in our mission to achieve a net\-zero electricity system by 2040\. ESB is Ireland’s leading energy utility, with activities spanning electricity generation, transmission and distribution, energy supply, energy services and international consultancy. Operating in Ireland, Northern Ireland and Great Britain, we invest over €1 billion each year to deliver a new energy future based on reliable, affordable zero\-carbon electricity.

jobs.title: Manager (Engineering), Digital Innovation Studio
jobs.description:
Family Group: Administration
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

**Job Title:**


Manager (Engineering), Digital Innovation Studio

  

**NHG Vision: Adding years of healthy life**  

**CHI Mission: Driving innovation for systems change**  

The Centre for Healthcare Innovation (CHI) is committed to catalysing and driving innovation for systems change in healthcare, thereby adding years of healthy life. Built on the foundation of co\-learning and collaboration, CHI’s core is in facilitating innovation through its suite of platforms and programmes. CHI has built a dynamic network of local and international partners who are dedicated to fostering innovation, creating thought leadership, co\-building initiatives to inculcate and embed a culture of innovation within healthcare. We spearhead innovation by driving the adoption of the CHI Innovation Cycle, care and process redesign and in the use of technology. CHI leads transformation at the care, systems and ecosystem levels to achieve better health and healthcare.  

**About the Digital Innovation Office (DIO)**  

  

The Digital Innovation Office (DIO) under the Centre for Healthcare Innovation (CHI) drives NHG Health’s digital transformation across three key platforms: Digital Hospital, Digital Community, and Health Empowered by AI Launchpad (HEAL).  

DIO’s mission is to enable transformation and deliver impact by supporting institution\-led platforms that advance workforce and care transformation. Through collaborative programmes and partnerships, DIO serves as a catalyst for AI adoption at scale and digital innovation across hospitals and community care.  

**JOB SUMMARY**  

Reporting to the Assistant Director, Digital Innovation Studio (DIS), the role will manage DIS’s proof\-of\-concept (POC) platforms consisting of multi\-cloud sandbox environments and maintain full technical understanding of their AI and/or IT standards. The candidate will undertake important technical activities together with NHG project teams for the robust prototyping of digital solutions that support CHI’s digital and AI\-enabled future.  

In addition, the candidate will participate in user\-engaged product iteration, and technology ecosystem stewardship—working closely with clinicians, operations teams, UX specialists, data scientists, and industry partners.  

**MAIN DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**  

1\. **Technical Prototype Engineering**


* Design and support the development of lightweight prototypes, including front\-end interfaces, back\-end services, and workflow components.
* Collaborate with project teams to define technical requirements and translate business needs into implementable solution designs, ensuring alignment with security and scalability considerations.
* Develop technical documentation such as PRDs that include human\-in\-the\-loop (HITL) workflow and guardrail/safety mechanisms, and architecture diagrams.
* Provide hands\-on support for prototype development, testing, and technical troubleshooting.

**2\. Sandbox Platform Management**
-----------------------------------

* Maintain DIS multi\-cloud sandbox environments across AWS, Azure and/or GCP, including user onboarding, resource provisioning, and access management .
* Manage and optimise additional enterprise prototyping platforms, ensuring users can effectively build solutions using pre\-established services and reusable architecture patterns.
* Engage industry cloud providers and healthcare IT vendors to stay abreast of emerging platforms, integration approaches, and capabilities, and advise project teams on designing prototypes aligned with target deployment environments.
  

**3\. Administrative support**
* Support DIS in secretariat or administrative work where needed.
* Design and deliver hands\-on training workshops on modern software development practices and the effective use of cloud\-based tools and platforms.
  

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**  

(A) EDUCATION, TRAINING AND EXPERIENCE  

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or equivalent.
* 5 years hands\-on engineering experience (front\-end or back\-end in cloud environment).
* Ability to build and iterate prototypes using both traditional development stacks (e.g. JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, .NET) and low\-code/no\-code tools within enterprise security constraints.
* Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS preferred), containerized deployments, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Proficient in drafting PRDs and creating pragmatic lightweight solution architectures to guide technical implementation
  

**Desired Skills*** Passion for healthcare and to create new solutions that can benefit patients or hospital systems.
* Experience working in healthcare, or with standards such as HL7/FHIR, is advantageous.
* Understanding of cybersecurity principles, data protection, and safe experimentation in enterprise settings.
* Experience working with vendors or external tech partners is a bonus.
* Flexible mindset to adopt new platforms and create new technical frameworks or processes in our evolving environment

jobs.title: Software Cloud Manager
jobs.description:
Job Purpose and Core Tasks
  
  

The Software Cloud Manager is a senior leadership\-role within the cloud development organization, combining deep hands\-on technical expertise with end\-to\-end ownership of global cloud delivery. This role is responsible for designing, building, and operating scalable, secure cloud solutions that underpin medical and non\-medical digital products across mobile and web platforms, used by customers globally. With significant experience in cloud software engineering, the Software Cloud Manager leads a distributed team across Israel and Singapore, directly managing engineers and driving cross\-functional initiatives that span product, architecture, operations, and quality. The role is accountable for setting technical direction, achieving delivery and reliability KPIs, and ensuring that cloud platforms can scale with business growth.
  
  

**Global team leadership:**  

Lead and develop a global engineering team located in Singapore and Israel, providing clear technical direction, coaching and performance management.
  
  

Build team capability through mentoring, structured feedback and talent development, ensuring succession and technical depth in critical cloud areas.
  
  

Architecture and technical ownership
  
  

Own architecture and design decisions for cloud capabilities across mobile and web, including APIs, dataflows, security, observability and deployment pipelines.
  
  

Ensure operational excellence across cloud environments, including monitoring, alerting, reliability, capacity management and incident response.
  
  

Evaluate and adopt cloud services (GCP, AWS or Azure) to balance cost, performance and reliability, and ensure designs meet regulatory and security requirements.
  
  

Execution and delivery accountability
  
  

Lead cloud development planning, prioritization and execution, translating product and business priorities into a clear backlog and delivery roadmap.
  
  

Take ownership for high quality, on time delivery of features and foundational cloud capabilities, using modern engineering practices (CI/CD, automated testing, code reviews).
  
  

Operational excellence and reliability
  
  

Ensure operational excellence across cloud environments, including monitoring, alerting, reliability, capacity management and incident response.
  
  

Define and track SLOs/SLAs for key services, lead post incident reviews, and drive continuous improvement to reduce downtime and improve user experience.
  
  

Cross functional leadership
  
  

Partner with Product Management, DataOps, QA, Security and other stakeholders to align cloud development with product roadmap and business outcomes.
  
  

Represent the cloud team in cross functional forums, communicate trade\-offs and risks clearly, and ensure stakeholders have transparency on progress and constraints.
  
  

Technical contributor
  
  

Contribute directly to complex technical tasks where needed (e.g. critical design, performance investigations, major refactors), while maintaining a strong focus on enabling the team.
  
  

Read and interpret complex technical documentation, troubleshoot end to end issues across stack layers, and provide practical solutions.
  
  

All other responsibilities as directed
  
  

I. Minimum Knowledge, Education and Skill Requirements
  
  

Required
  
  

**Minimum years of relevant work experience:**  

7\+ years of experience in software engineering with a focus on cloud\-based architectures and distributed systems.
  
  

Proven experience with major cloud providers (GCP, AWS or Azure), including design and operation of production workloads.
  
  

Ability to define and drive engineering excellence standards (code quality, testing, documentation, observability).
  
  

Experience withGit\-based source control and collaborative development workflows (branching, pull requests, code reviews).
  
  

Track record of successfully delivering cross‑functional global cloud projects from design through rollout and operations, with measurable impact on product or customer outcomes.
  
  

**Minimum education, certifications and/or credentials:**  

BSc/MSc in Computer Science or related engineering degree.
  
  

Strong proficiency in Python and C\# (or similar languages such as Java) for backend services and automation.
  
  

Solid understanding of web technologies, including RESTful APIs, HTML, JavaScript, and modern frameworks.
  
  

**Minimum soft skill requirements:**  

Demonstrated experience leading engineers directly, including responsibility for performance management, coaching and team development.
  
  

Ability to work independently, take ownership of complex topics and move them forward with minimal supervision.
  
  

High level of problem\-solving ability, with a practical, solution\-oriented mindset and resilience under pressure.
  
  

Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to work effectively across time zones and cultures.
  
  

KARL STORZ VentureONE Pte. Ltd. is a fully owned subsidiary of KARL STORZ SE \& Co. KG headquartered in Singapore with a business focus on robotic solutions, artificial intelligence, and virtual reality.

jobs.title: Process Validation Engineer Cell Therapy
jobs.description:
**What is offered?**
--------------------



At MindCapture you are not just starting a new role. You are joining a community that invests in your development and gives you the opportunity to grow in a meaningful technical career within healthcare.



You can count on:


* A competitive salary with a full benefits package including meal vouchers, eco vouchers, health insurance, group insurance, net expense allowance and a company car with charging or fuel card
* Personal growth support with tailored training and clear career development
* A stable environment where your technical skills directly contribute to improved patient care
* The chance to work with high tech diagnostic systems at top tier healthcare institutions
* A warm and collaborative culture focused on trust, ownership and long term impact


**Job description**
-------------------


As Process Validation Engineer, you will coordinate validation activities within a new manufacturing environment. Your scope includes process validation, sterilisation validation, technology transfer, equipment introduction and technical documentation while ensuring compliance with current regulatory and GMP requirements.


**Key responsibilities**


* Validation strategy: Define, plan and coordinate PPQ, smoke studies, hold time validation, APQ and APS activities.
* Validation guidance: Provide technical guidance on validation and qualification activities.
* Revalidation: Ensure timely revalidation of manufacturing and sterilisation processes.
* Documentation: Write, review and approve validation plans, protocols and reports.
* Technology transfer: Participate in product transfer and manufacturing system introduction activities.
* Process improvement: Contribute to optimisation projects for manufacturing systems and processes.
* Compliance review: Review technical documentation against regulatory requirements and current industry practices.
* Project reporting: Provide accurate and timely progress updates to stakeholders and leadership.
**Required competences \& skills**
----------------------------------


* Education: Bachelor degree or higher in engineering, biotechnology, biomedical sciences or pharmacy.
* Industry experience: Experience within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, cell therapy or a related regulated industry.
* Manufacturing knowledge: Experience introducing pharmaceutical products into manufacturing environments.
* Technical expertise: Working knowledge of manufacturing operations and late stage development activities.
* GMP knowledge: Strong working knowledge of current Good Manufacturing Practices.
* Aseptic experience: Experience within controlled cleanroom environments under aseptic conditions is a plus.
* Project management: Ability to manage activities, priorities and reporting in a structured way.
* Problem solving: Strong decision making and problem solving skills under changing priorities.
* Collaboration: Ability to work independently while interacting effectively across organisational levels.
* Languages: Fluent written and spoken Dutch and English.
**CQV**
**Ghent**
**Medior**
**At MindCapture as consultant**
**About this application**
--------------------------


This opportunity is offered through MindCapture as a consultancy role with strong day to day ownership. You will be placed on site with our client.


MindCapture supports you throughout your assignment with clear onboarding, regular follow up and access to learning opportunities. You will have a dedicated point of contact, transparent communication and support to help you deliver impact in a structured way.


**Job Contact –** **Talent \& Business Team**
---------------------------------------------


Our Talent \& Business Managers combine a deep understanding of our clients’ needs with a sharp eye for talent. Their focus is on creating meaningful and sustainable matches, always keeping both the role and the candidate in mind.


When a potential match is identified, one of our T\&B colleagues may reach out to answer your questions, share additional context about the role and discuss possible next steps together, with clarity and transparency throughout the process.


**How our application process works**
-------------------------------------


* **Apply online** – Submit your application in just a few clicks.

* **Personal interview** – If we see a potential match, our team reaches out to get to know you better, explore your skills and ambitions and hear what you value in your next challenge.

* **Client introduction** – We match you with potential projects and introduce you to clients where your expertise fits best.

* **Client interview \& feedback** – You meet with the client to explore project details and expectations, while we support you throughout the discussions and provide follow\-up afterwards.

* **Final interview \& welcome** – In a final chat with our team, we close the process and warmly welcome you to MindCapture, guiding you towards a smooth start with us or at the client site.

jobs.title: Software Designer (C#, C++, Java)
jobs.description:
As a Software Designer C#/C++/JAVA, you develop software for high-tech products and machines.

In this role, you support our customers in the semiconductor, analytical instrumentation, and medical equipment industries, within the triangle of Nijmegen, Enschede, and Zwolle, by delivering smart, sustainable, and reliable software solutions. Your software expertise plays an essential role in bringing these high-tech solutions to life.

What excites you as a Software Designer (C#, C++, Java)?

As a Software Designer, you contribute to defining requirements and you are responsible for translating them into robust software designs, ensuring high-quality implementation and seamless integration. You are eager to grow into a role where you bring your own technical contribution, while guiding the development team.

From our office in Mijdrecht and at our clients' premises you work on challenging projects that take technology to the next level. You are the expert who designs, develops, and tests, but also likes to think along, connect, and contribute to team results, and who likes to:

Translating customer and system requirements into innovative, clear, and feasible concepts during the conceptual phase of projects.
Acting as a bridge between architects and engineers from a technical perspective.
Taking responsibility for a module/subsystem throughout the entire software development lifecycle.
Ensuring software quality, scalability and maintainability through sound engineering practices.
Applying strong communication skills to effectively guide and mentor a team of engineers, helping them grow and deliver high-quality results.

Sounds good? We’d love to tell you more…

Your future workplace

This is what you bring to the table

You have a technical Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Computer Engineering.
You have 7+ years of experience in technical software development, gained in various roles and across diverse product environments and/or projects.
Over the past 4–5 years, you have worked within technical domains such as Semicon, Medical, or Analytical.
You have experience with at least two of the following programming languages: C#, C++, or Java.
You have knowledge of and/or experience with various development methodologies and techniques such as Design Patterns, UML, and Agile, and you keep your technical expertise up to date. You are looking for an environment where you can apply these developments in practice as well.
Based on your experience, you are able to coach junior engineers.
You are a team player and keep the common goal in mind.
You have a good command of both Dutch and English, spoken and written.
You hold a valid European driver’s license and are willing to travel.

This is what you can expect in return from Sioux

Flexible 32-40 hour working week, with room to work from home.
A healthy work-life balance is very important to us. We have 28 holidays with an option to acquire an additional 12 holidays.
You will work with passionate colleagues who share your drive for technology and business success.
By combining our expertise in software, electronics, mechanics, mechatronics, mathematics and assembly, we make the impossible possible for our customers and get to work on challenging high-tech projects.
You get a lot of freedom and responsibility; after all, you know exactly what you are doing.
Personal coaching and a training budget of €6000 per year, so that you can continue to develop yourself.
We also find it important to have fun together. We organize a lot for our employees, from events together with your partner and family, summer barbecues, innovative knowledge sessions to tasty lunches and after work drinks.
You will be working at a prime location in a green, wooded environment, close to the Veluwe National Park. The perfect base within the triangle of Enschede, Zwolle, and Nijmegen.

High Tech & High Fun

We can tell you all about the typical Sioux-culture and the high-tech challenging projects. About how you can develop yourself, like nowhere else. But we’d rather have you hear it from our own employees.

If you want to know more about our challenging projects, please click here.
